headline: Gatchalian Urges DepEd to Fill 133 New Inclusive-Education Specialist Posts
seoTitle: Gatchalian Pushes 133 DepEd Inclusive-Education Posts | FMB News
seoDescription: Senate President Win Gatchalian urged DepEd to quickly fill 133 newly approved specialist positions supporting learners with disabilities under the Inclusive Education Act.
deck: The newly approved posts include education specialists, physical therapists and occupational therapists intended to strengthen services for learners with disabilities.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: Senate President Win Gatchalian urged the Department of Education to accelerate hiring for 133 newly approved plantilla positions intended to support learners with disabilities.

Current reporting says the positions include Senior Education Program Specialists, Education Program Specialists II, Physical Therapists II and Occupational Therapists, and form part of the implementation of Republic Act No. 11650, the Inclusive Education for Learners with Disabilities Act.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: RA 11650 directs the government to expand inclusive education services and develop Inclusive Learning Resource Centers and the personnel needed to support them. Gatchalian has argued that creating the positions is only useful if qualified personnel are actually recruited and deployed.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: Specialized personnel can help schools assess learning needs, deliver therapy and support teachers and families. Persistent vacancies weaken the practical effect of inclusive-education funding even when positions already exist on paper.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Watch DepEd and DBM for recruitment timelines, regional deployment plans and updates on how quickly the 133 positions are filled, especially in areas with limited access to allied health and special-education professionals.
